analysis:
Examined both files' metadata, patches, and all supplied source excerpts. Changes are documentation only within this batch: changelog.d/overlapped-weight-verification.md:3–9 describes threaded read/hash overlap across startup, download, prefetch and cache-enabled load verification; docs/reference/configuration.md:621–625 (head patch) specifies two page-aligned buffers and 4 MiB read-ahead while retaining uncached reads and existing fallbacks. No concrete security regression is established by these descriptions. Surrounding configuration excerpts do not change authorization, attestation, credentials, encryption, billing or local control boundaries.
The security-sensitive contract is unchanged weight digests (A-004, T-012, T-027), including fresh load verification supporting SSD cache identity bindings (T-041/TB-007). Documentation claims do not verify that contract. Integration must examine WeightHasher.hashSingleFileUncached and OverlappedFileDigest implementation changes for buffer ownership/synchronization, ordered and complete hashing, short-read/EOF/error handling, worker cleanup and bounded memory/thread concurrency. It should confirm that fallbacks and pre/post-load verification still fail appropriately and do not publish an incomplete digest. Those implementations are absent from this batch; this is a material coverage limit, not evidence of a missing control or a vulnerability.
